## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing, and HYG (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND with LQD (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND signaling credit functioning; nevertheless narrow breadth keeps regime cautious.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit health improving: HYG (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND → flat. Reflation bid intact: CPER (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-benign: SPY vs TLT (Stocks vs Bonds) (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Dollar softening: UUP proxy (Dollar Strength Level) (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -0.36%) BELOW TREND → flat; yield curve modestly steepening (Yield Curve Level 1.0459 ↑ rising RECOVERY).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) ABOVE TREND showing strong momentum. Weak spots: XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -5.15%) BELOW TREND; style: Growth/momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?
US strong: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +8.49%) ABOVE TREND. EM leadership visible: EEM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +12.71%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +2.62%) ABOVE TREND — China tech still mixed relative to US tech.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Cooling but present: Speculation Index (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +5.18%) CORRECTION. Risk-on vehicles remain elevated: IBIT (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +11.10%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +14.80%) ABOVE TREND; small caps IWM (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.48%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Refla­tion bias: CPER (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND showing industrial/metal strength. Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +2.50% | 1M: -0.95%) RECOVERY — safe-haven flows modest.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -7.26% | 1M: +9.46%) CORRECTION show near-term weakness amid mixed 1M signals. Natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech (XLK (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) ABOVE TREND) and QQQ (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND showing consistent strength. DIVERGENCE: Sector breadth narrow (4/11) and defensive sectors (XLE, XLU) BELOW TREND — narrow leadership increases tail‑risk.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum ETFs (XLK (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to lagging energy/utilities (XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND, XLU (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -5.15%) BELOW TREND); monitor credit and breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology/semis — XLK (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: Energy/Utilities — XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -5.15%) BELOW TREND on weak flows.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND as reflation signal. BEARISH: Oil volatility — BNO (1W: -7.26% | 1M: +9.46%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.35% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.13% ABOVE TREND) — watch HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 for credit signal. XLK/ XLF spread (XLK (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND) — watch relative gap for rotation risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND provide confirmation but narrow breadth keeps risk elevated. Technology (XLK (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength; energy (XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND) and utilities weak. Key divergence to monitor: narrow leadership (4/11) — if breadth fails to expand, downside risk rises.
